item.title: TECOM Group Bolsters Digital Economy with the Launch of AED 615mn

item.description: In a landmark collaboration uniting the global real estate and luxury automotive industries, Binghatti Developers, Dubai’s largest and fastest-growing property developer, and Mercedes-Benz, the world-renowned luxury automotive brand, have announced the launch of Mercedes-Benz Places – Binghatti City, the world’s first Mercedes-Benz-branded city, with a total investment value of AED 30 billion.
